text: 韩国《首尔经济》报道称，13日上午韩国股市暴跌，外国投资者继续抛售三星电子和SK海力士股票。韩国《朝鲜日报》13日报道，据韩国交易所13日公布的数据，从年初首个交易日 (1月2日) 到10月12日，外资在KOSPI市场累计净卖出199.10万亿韩元（约合人民币9925亿元）。
text_en: South Korea's Seoul Economic Daily reported that on the morning of the 13th, the South Korean stock market plunged, with foreign investors continuing to sell off Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix shares. South Korea's Chosun Ilbo reported on the 13th that, according to data released by the Korea Exchange on the 13th, from the first trading day of the year (January 2) to October 12, foreign investors recorded cumulative net selling of 199.10 trillion won (approximately 992.5 billion yuan) in the KOSPI market.
